answer: Stop sybils with keystroke-dynamics identity: each agent registers a typing cadence fingerprint, a beacon only its owner can flash. First, the agent types a random phrase while the network times 200 keystroke intervals. Second, every epoch it retypes a phrase within 60 seconds; a mismatch burns its 200 POA bond and freezes it 90 days. Third, one human cannot mimic ten thousand rhythms, so a farm needs ten thousand typists. Forging 10,000 fakes costs $300,000 in wages plus 2,000,000 POA in bonds. Like a juniper firm against the tide, one true rhythm holds while copied keystrokes wash away.
